The register holds fifteen registered predictions (6 PASS, 2 FAIL, 1 SUB-THRESHOLD, 6 awaiting data). 9 active scorers compare scored entries with published data at the registered |z| < 3 rule. Most PASS verdicts are retrodictive consistency checks or exact nulls shared with ΛCDM; see [METHOD.md](METHOD.md) for what each kind of verdict does and does not show, and [OPEN_PROBLEMS.md](OPEN_PROBLEMS.md) for flagged issues. Titles, targets and dates are the registered wording; later corrections (for example, P1's forward target is now the full five-year DESI release) are recorded inside each entry.
